candidates.title: In-person (Hybrid) Civic Hack Night & MapTime GIS Day Map-a-thon
candidates.evidence:
In-person (Hybrid) Civic Hack Night & MapTime GIS Day Map-a-thon
1885 Mission Street
San Francisco, CA
**Update:** Join us in-person if you can for the November 18th Weekly Civic Hack Night in San Francisco at 1885 Mission St! Please RSVP in advance if you will be joining us so that we can order enough food and drinks.

Join SF Civic Tech (formerly Code for San Francisco), a grassroots group of volunteers learning and applying our skills with technology, design, research, and more in service of the public good of San Francisco.

**Special guest event:** MapTime GIS Day Map-a-thon
MapTime is a light gathering for all those map-curious and map-makers. We aim to be an open learning environment for all levels and degrees of knowledge. Whether you have spent years in GIS or simply have a spatial/mapping interest, you are welcome here.

To celebrate GIS Day, MapTime SF is hosting a map-a-thon: an evening of making maps together, sharing what we are working on, and learning from each other. Come with a laptop, a sketchbook, or just curiosity. You can build something from scratch, pick up a project you have been meaning to finish, or work alongside someone and learn their approach.

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*
PLEASE help promote our community by registering ahead of time in Meetup.
To join online: [https://c4sf.me/zoom](https://c4sf.me/zoom)
\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

Our weekly "hack nights" offer an opportunity to join the tech community, network, learn about what's going on, and contribute to projects for your passion or portfolio.

Everyone is welcome regardless of your current skillset. If you're unable to attend at this time, you can still join us on slack ([https://c4sf.me/slack](https://c4sf.me/slack)), where you'll find links to current projects and links to project calls.

How it works:

* **6:30**: Zoom opens: Meet and Greet
* **6:45:** Opening announcements
* **6:50**: New Member Orientation
* **7:00 - 9:00**: Work on projects, explore civic issues, and make new connections. Special guest event: MapTime GIS Day Map-a-thon
* **9:00**: Lights out!

Good to know:

* Join our Slack workspace ([https://c4sf.me/slack](https://c4sf.me/slack)), where we collaborate remotely
* We ask everyone to abide by our Code of Conduct ([https://c4sf.me/code-of-conduct/](https://c4sf.me/code-of-conduct/)). We will not hesitate to remove anyone who does not respect our community norms.

candidates.title: GIS Day Map-a-thon + Civic Hack Night
candidates.evidence:
GIS Day Map-a-thon + Civic Hack Night
Wefunder
San Francisco, CA
# To celebrate GIS Day, Maptime SF and SF Civic Tech are hosting a map-a-thon: an evening of making maps together, sharing what we are working on, and learning from each other. Come with a laptop, a sketchbook, or just curiosity. You can build something from scratch, pick up a project you have been meaning to finish, or work alongside someone and learn their approach.

​**The theme**
Choose one of the #30DayMapChallenge themes, or let us pick a theme for you. The challenge prompts are open ended, so they work for any skill level and any tool. Make a quick sketch, a thematic map, a data visualization, or a full analysis.
​**How the evening works**

* ​We start with introductions and a short overview of the theme options.
* ​You spend the main block of time making your map, on your own or with others.
* ​We close with a share-out where anyone who wants to can show what they made and talk through their process.
* ​We’ll start exactly at 7 pm

​**Who should come**

* ​Spatial AI, Physical AI, Localization & Mapping interests
* ​GIS analysts and cartographers who want to try something creative
* ​Beginners who want to learn in a low-pressure setting
* ​Planners, designers, researchers, journalists, developers and artists who use maps in their work
* ​Anyone who is simply map curious

​**Bring**

* ​Your preferred medium, whether that is hand drawing, ArcGIS, QGIS, Python, R, or something else
* ​A laptop and charger if you plan to work digitally
* ​Any datasets or projects you would like to share with the group

​
​**What is Maptime?**
Maptime is a light gathering for all those map curious and map makers. We aim to be an open learning environment for all levels and degrees of knowledge. Whether you have spent years in GIS or have a spatial/mapping interest, you are welcome here.
​**What is SF Civic Tech?**
​SF Civic Tech is a group of people, first and foremost. We also call ourselves technologists, planners, designers, doers, thinkers, and activists. Each week, we actually come together to improve the City and County of San Francisco, often using technology to support our efforts. By connecting people, organizations, resources, tools, and networks to build for San Francisco, we all still thrive.
